C0801.title: Ele.me Sales Manager Assisted Merchant with Unauthorized Listing and Accepted Bribes
C0801.summary: Fang, a sales manager at an Ele.me branch responsible for business development and merchant maintenance, was approached in June 2017 by restaurant owner Zhang through the platform's customer service. Zhang asked Fang to list two restaurants with different licenses on the platform and gave him 5,000 yuan in cash. Despite knowing the company prohibited duplicate listings at the same business address
